label: My return: tax slabs of each year since FY 2015-16

params.name: years
params.label: individual's slab rates, 87A rebate (up to / at most; marginal relief in the new regime from FY 2023-24) and cess by financial year (the year it starts) and regime - old regime from FY 2015-16, the new regime (s.115BAC) from FY 2020-21. Finance Acts 2015 to 2025: 87A 2,000 (2015-16), 5,000 (2016-17), 2,500 up to 3.5 lakh (2017-18, 2018-19), 12,500 up to 5 lakh (2019-20 on); new regime 25,000 up to 7 lakh (2023-24, 2024-25), 60,000 up to 12 lakh (2025-26); cess 3% to 2017-18, 4% from 2018-19. FY 2025-26 is chip myreturn.rates'.

params.name: new_default_from
params.label: the new regime is the default from FY 2023-24 (Finance Act 2023); before it a year's regime is the old unless said

params.name: surcharge_above
params.label: surcharge is not worked out for an earlier year: a year's income over 50 lakh - a CA

description_nl: 2026-10-07: The individual's slabs, 87A rebate and cess for FY 2015-16 to FY 2025-26, both regimes - for relief u/s 89 (Form 10E) and the updated return of an earlier year.
